x: A good field turned out for this race, including Bill Bird our second claim member, and of course Pete Newell the holder. From the start Bill took the field along at a very brisk pace and by the half distance only Pete Newell was still with him.

Walker had moved ahead and was some twenty places in front of Dabbs, with Bill Bird, second claim to Bels., just ahead. David had moved ahead of Eric who was losing a little ground, whilst Clive Shippen and Eddie Short had maintained their positions.
Bill Bird, as is his wont, was soon setting the pace with Bob Norton at his shoulder, and at 3 laps a group of eight had detached itself from the field.
He had his first serious dabble at 3 miling during this time, and in the L.C.C.Championships finished 3rd behind Pat Newell and Bill Bird in a best ever 14:30.2 - a time he is not proud of.
